cast.name: The shopper
cast.note: Young woman in a pink tee, olive shoulder bag

cast.name: Shop assistant
cast.note: Only the hand and forearm reach into frame

shots.frame: A young woman in a pink tee pulls open a metal shutter door, the sunlit alley and parked cars behind her
shots.rhythmNote: Opens on her back as she pushes the shutter open — no face yet, so you watch to find out who

shots.frame: The camera follows her from behind along the pavement, past a lit bakery window stacked with bread and pedestrians crossing the frame
shots.rhythmNote: A ten-second walk lays out the street and where she is heading, unbroken

shots.frame: Both hands cradle the phone at chest height, the camera app open on screen and her thumb resting beside the shutter button
shots.rhythmNote: The phone fills the frame with the camera app open — the product finally lands

shots.frame: Across the glass counter the assistant's hand slides a boxed phone toward her, price cards and display units lined up beside it
shots.rhythmNote: The boxed phone slides across the counter into her hands: the walk gets its result

shots.frame: She steps out of the shop doorway holding the box against her bag and walks off down the sloping street, traffic light ahead
shots.rhythmNote: She leaves with the box down the sloping street, closing the errand
